impact: After running `pnpm build`, vitest picks up compiled test files from dist/ and fails with "Vitest cannot be imported in a CommonJS module using require()". The 97 source tests all pass but 3 suites error. Fix: add `include: ["src/**/*.test.ts"]` to vitest.config.ts.
title: vitest scans dist/ compiled test files — fails with CJS/ESM error after any build
